steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width, toes turned out a little.

bodyweight-squat.tip: Keep your knees in line with your toes; don't let them cave in.

steps: Hold the weight in front of your chest with both hands, close to your body.

steps: Stand with one foot forward and one back, like a static lunge.

steps: Sit on the edge of a chair with your feet hip-width apart.

Sit back down slowly and with control.
sit-to-stand.tip: Don't use your hands unless you need to.

steps: Stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Place one whole foot on the box and push through that leg to step up.
Step down slowly and with control, then switch legs.
step-up.tip: Use a sturdy box and don't push off with the lower foot.

steps: Feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and bring your torso forward with a flat back; the weight travels down close to your legs.
Squeeze your glutes, drive your hips forward and stand tall.
hip-hinge.tip: The movement comes from your hips, not your back; don't round your back.

steps: Feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and bring your torso forward with a flat back; the weight travels down close to your legs.
Squeeze your glutes, drive your hips forward and stand tall.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line.

steps: Hands behind your head or a bar on your shoulders, knees slightly bent.
Send your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back until it is nearly parallel to the floor.

band-good-morning.tip: Start with a small range so your hamstrings can warm up.

steps: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels.

pushup.tip: Don't let your hips rise or sag; keep your abs tight.

steps: Knees on the floor, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.

knee-pushup.tip: A step before full push-ups; build up the reps gradually.

steps: Stand facing a wall and place your palms on it at shoulder height.

steps: Stand facing a wall and place your palms on it at shoulder height.

steps: Lie on the bench with your feet flat on the floor and shoulder blades pulled together.

steps: Lie on your back with arms toward the ceiling and knees up at 90 degrees.

Hold your glutes tight for a moment, then lower slowly.
band-glute-bridge.tip: Feel it in your glutes, not your lower back.

steps: Loop the band above your knees or around your ankles and sit back slightly.
Take short steps to the side without letting the band go slack.
Go back the other way.
band-lateral-walk.tip: Keep your knees in line with your toes; don't let them cave in.

steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and legs stacked.
Keep your feet together and open your top knee.
Close slowly; then do the other side.
Get on all fours.
Push one leg toward the ceiling with the knee bent.
Lower slowly; finish your reps, then switch legs.
band-kickback.tip: Don't arch your lower back; the movement comes from your glutes.

steps: Hold the weight at shoulder height, abs and glutes tight.
Press the weight straight overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower with control to your shoulders.
band-shoulder-press.tip: Don't arch your back; if you do, use a lighter weight.

steps: Hold the weight in front of your thighs with your hands close together.
Pull the weight up close to your body to below your chest, elbows above your wrists.
Lower slowly.
band-upright-row.tip: If your shoulder hurts, don't go above chest height.

steps: Stand facing the cable and hold the handle, elbows at your sides.
Push the handle down until your arms are straight.
Let your forearms rise slowly, elbows fixed.
Sit with knees bent and torso leaning back slightly.
Hold your hands or a weight in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to the left and right.
band-woodchop.tip: The rotation comes from your torso; lift your feet off the floor to make it harder.

steps: Stand tall and take a long step forward.
Bend both knees until your back knee is near the floor.
Push through your front foot to return to the start, then switch legs.
kettlebell-lunge.tip: Keep your torso upright and don't let the front knee cave in.

steps: Hold the weights at your sides and stand tall.
Walk with short, steady steps.
Keep your shoulders down and your abs tight.
Hold the weight at shoulder height, abs and glutes tight.
Press the weight straight overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower with control to your shoulders.
kettlebell-halo.tip: Don't arch your back; if you do, use a lighter weight.

steps: Stand tall and raise your arms overhead.
Lean slowly to one side until you feel a stretch along your side.
Come back and do the other side.
kettlebell-windmill.tip: The stretch should be gentle, never painful.

steps: Hold the weight at your shoulders and squat.
Stand up powerfully and carry that drive into pressing the weight overhead.
Bring the weight back to your shoulders and squat again.
medicine-ball-slam.tip: Make it one smooth movement; the power comes from your legs.

steps: Hold the kettlebell with both hands, feet slightly wider than your shoulders.
Swing the weight back between your legs and send your hips back.
Snap your hips forward hard so the weight rises to chest height.
dumbbell-snatch.tip: The power comes from your hips, not your arms and shoulders.

steps: Hold the weight at your shoulders and squat.
Stand up powerfully and carry that drive into pressing the weight overhead.
Bring the weight back to your shoulders and squat again.
dumbbell-clean.tip: Make it one smooth movement; the power comes from your legs.

steps: Stand tall and take a long step forward.
Bend both knees until your back knee is near the floor.
Push through your front foot to return to the start, then switch legs.
goblet-reverse-lunge.tip: Keep your torso upright and don't let the front knee cave in.

steps: Feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and bring your torso forward with a flat back; the weight travels down close to your legs.
Squeeze your glutes, drive your hips forward and stand tall.
dumbbell-romanian-deadlift-single.tip: The movement comes from your hips, not your back; don't round your back.

steps: Hold the weight in front of your thighs.
With nearly straight arms, raise the weight forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Hold the weight in front of your chest with both hands, close to your body.
As in a regular squat, send your hips back and down so your elbows come between your knees.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes at the top.
landmine-squat.tip: Keep the weight close to your chest so your back doesn't round.

steps: Feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and bring your torso forward with a flat back; the weight travels down close to your legs.
Squeeze your glutes, drive your hips forward and stand tall.
cable-pull-through.tip: The movement comes from your hips, not your back; don't round your back.

steps: Stand with one foot forward and one back, like a static lunge.
Lower your body straight down until your back knee is near the floor.
Push through your front foot to rise; finish all reps, then switch legs.
smith-lunge.tip: Keep most of your weight on the front leg.

steps: Hold the weight at shoulder height, abs and glutes tight.
Press the weight straight overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower with control to your shoulders.
smith-shoulder-press.tip: Don't arch your back; if you do, use a lighter weight.

steps: Knees slightly bent, bring your torso forward with a flat back.
Pull the weight toward your lower belly and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Straighten your arms slowly.
smith-row.tip: Don't shrug your shoulders or round your back.

steps: Sit on the machine with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle toward your belly and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Slowly reach your arms forward without bending your torso.
cable-row-single-arm.tip: Don't swing your torso to move the weight.

steps: Set the cable rope at face height and hold both ends.
Pull the rope toward your face, keeping your elbows high and wide.
Reach your arms forward slowly.
cable-face-pull-high.tip: Great for shoulder health; keep the weight light.

steps: Hold the weight in front of your thighs.
With nearly straight arms, raise the weight forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Stand with your back to the band or cable anchor, handles beside your chest.
Press your arms straight forward.
Return slowly.
Hold the weight overhead with both hands.
Bend your elbows and lower the weight behind your head.
Use your triceps to straighten your arms.
cable-overhead-triceps.tip: Keep your elbows pointing forward; don't let them flare.

steps: Stand tall, weight in hand and elbows at your sides.
Bend only your forearm and curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Straighten your arm slowly.
cable-hammer-curl.tip: Keep your elbows from moving back and forth; don't swing your torso.

steps: Stand tall, weight in hand and elbows at your sides.
Bend only your forearm and curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Straighten your arm slowly.
machine-preacher-curl.tip: Keep your elbows from moving back and forth; don't swing your torso.

steps: Support yourself on two bars with straight arms.
Bend your elbows and lower your body as far as your shoulders feel comfortable.
Push the bars away to rise back up.
machine-triceps-dip.tip: If your shoulder hurts, skip this exercise or shorten the range.

steps: Dumbbells at your sides, elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
machine-lateral-raise.tip: Don't swing the weight up; keep it light and controlled.

steps: Lie on your stomach with your arms stretched forward.
At the same time, lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.
machine-back-extension.tip: Don't crane your neck; look at the floor.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands beside your head.
Brace your abs and lift your head and shoulder blades slightly off the floor.
Lower slowly.
machine-ab-crunch.tip: Don't pull on your neck; look at the ceiling.

steps: Sit on the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety and slowly bend your knees to lower the platform.
Push the platform away without locking your knees.
vertical-leg-press.tip: Keep your back and hips on the seat.

steps: Rest the bar on the muscles of your upper back (not on your neck) and grip it firmly.
Take a breath, brace your abs and send your hips back and down.
Go to parallel or slightly lower, then drive up through your whole foot.
pendulum-squat.tip: If you're new, start with an empty bar and a spotter nearby.

steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width, toes turned out a little.
Send your hips back and down as if sitting onto a chair; keep your chest up and your back straight.
Go as low as you can while your back stays straight, then drive up through your heels.
belt-squat.tip: Keep your knees in line with your toes; don't let them cave in.

steps: Knees slightly bent, bring your torso forward with a flat back.
Pull the weight toward your lower belly and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Straighten your arms slowly.
chest-supported-row.tip: Don't shrug your shoulders or round your back.

steps: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows at about 45 degrees and lower your chest toward the floor.
Push the floor away and return to the top.
renegade-row.tip: Don't let your hips rise or sag; keep your abs tight.

steps: Lie on the bench with your feet flat on the floor and shoulder blades pulled together.
Lower the weight with control to the middle of your chest.
Press the weight straight up until your arms are straight.
dumbbell-floor-press.tip: Always have a spotter with heavy weights.

steps: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows at about 45 degrees and lower your chest toward the floor.
Push the floor away and return to the top.
trx-atomic-pushup.tip: Don't let your hips rise or sag; keep your abs tight.

steps: Get into a push-up position with straight arms.
Bring one knee toward your chest and back.
Switch legs quickly, one after the other.
trx-mountain-climber.tip: Keep your shoulders over your hands and your hips from rising.

steps: Hold the handles and lean back with a straight body.
Pull your chest up toward your hands and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly to the start.
trx-power-pull.tip: The more horizontal your body, the harder the movement.

steps: Stand with your back to the TRX anchor, handles in front of your chest.
Lean your straight body forward and bend your elbows to lower your chest.
Push the handles and return.
trx-chest-fly.tip: The farther back your feet are, the harder it is.

steps: Stand tall and take a long step forward.
Bend both knees until your back knee is near the floor.
Push through your front foot to return to the start, then switch legs.
trx-reverse-lunge.tip: Keep your torso upright and don't let the front knee cave in.

steps: Forearms under your shoulders, legs extended, on your toes.
Brace your abs and glutes so your body forms one straight line.
Stay there and breathe calmly.
trx-side-plank.tip: If your lower back hurts, put your knees down.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line.
Hold your glutes tight for a moment, then lower slowly.
trx-hip-press.tip: Feel it in your glutes, not your lower back.

steps: Hold the handles and lean back with a straight body.
Pull your chest up toward your hands and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly to the start.
trx-face-pull.tip: The more horizontal your body, the harder the movement.

steps: Lower as in a squat.
Jump up powerfully and raise your arms.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next squat.
Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width, toes turned out a little.
Send your hips back and down as if sitting onto a chair; keep your chest up and your back straight.
Go as low as you can while your back stays straight, then drive up through your heels.
trx-overhead-squat.tip: Keep your knees in line with your toes; don't let them cave in.

steps: Get into a push-up position with straight arms.
Bring one knee toward your chest and back.
Switch legs quickly, one after the other.
trx-crunch.tip: Keep your shoulders over your hands and your hips from rising.

steps: Stand tall.
Raise your knees to hip height, one after the other.
Move your arms in time with your legs.
step-touch.tip: A gentle start for warming up or low-energy days.

steps: Stand tall.
Raise your knees to hip height, one after the other.
Move your arms in time with your legs.
standing-knee-to-elbow.tip: A gentle start for warming up or low-energy days.

steps: Hold the weight at shoulder height, abs and glutes tight.
Press the weight straight overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower with control to your shoulders.
wall-angels.tip: Don't arch your back; if you do, use a lighter weight.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line.
Hold your glutes tight for a moment, then lower slowly.
glute-bridge-march.tip: Feel it in your glutes, not your lower back.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line.
Hold your glutes tight for a moment, then lower slowly.
frog-pump.tip: Feel it in your glutes, not your lower back.

steps: Kneel and anchor your heels under something sturdy.
Lower your straight body forward very slowly.
Catch yourself with your hands and return.
nordic-curl.tip: Very demanding; start with a small range.

steps: Hang from the bar.
Use your abs to raise your legs as high as you can (bent knees are easier).
Lower slowly without swinging.
l-sit.tip: Don't swing; if it's hard, bend your knees.

steps: Facing the wall, place your hands on the floor.
Walk your feet up one at a time and rest them against the wall.
Keep your body straight and come down slowly.
handstand.tip: An advanced move; only when fully ready and on a soft surface.
